mentions.name: mock
mentions.description: A tool for easily creating mock APIs for testing and automation, designed to make the process as simple as possible because existing tools for this purpose fall short.
mentions.problem: Existing tools for creating APIs for testing and automation aren't good enough.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on mock:
https://dhuan.github.io/mock/

the process of creating APIs for testing and automation should be as easy possible. the tools that exist nowadays for this purpose aren't good enough IMHO, which led me to build it.
